subtitles.text:
The Cat With the Dough: TAMAKI
Annual Turnover: 500 million rupies (approx.)
Taiyaki Stall Owner
Is that lady from the Mercurius Foundation?
Oh! I know her!
She's the girl from the taiyaki stand!
That stall's the bomb! It's a flavor sensation!
I oughtta take you guys!
It can be one of you two's treat!

The Human Calculator: YUKARI
Annual Income: Confidential
Mercurius Foundation Treasurer
A financier from the guild setting the stock market on fire?!
Hrm. Her mild-mannered face conceals untold talent...
Not unlike myself, I should say!
In the terms of the layfolk, she's a go-getter!

The All-Purpose Mercenary: MIFUYU
Annual Income: Confidential
(Part-Timer) DRAGON SLAYER
My! Even the fabled Dragon Slayer?!
Uh, it literally says "part-timer" there.
What's that job title, anyway. Does it outrank a manager?
Dragon Slay... Wait, she's killed a dragon?
That's... pretty cool.
Why, it's the legendary Miss Akino!

The Merchant Princess: AKINO
Total Assets: 7 trillion rupies (approx.), Heir to House Wisteria
They say she treats airships as disposable trinkets!
Air... ships? Like, those priceless airborne liners?!
Oh my. I had heard that they were already
available for reservation among the upper classes, but...
No way.
She uses luxury vehicles like they were paper cups?
Gulp.

St. Theresa's Academy (Friendship Club)
Average Allowance: 5000 rupies/month
Scholarship Seekers (Will Abandon Principles for Hard Cash)

St. Theresa's Academy Special Transfer Student
Average Allowance: Depends on Kokkoro
Whiz-Boy (By Lucent Academy Standards)
Good day to you, young ladies!
I am the Mercurius Foundation's guildmaster,
Akino Wisteria herself!
Wait, House Wisteria?!
The family that funds everything under the sun, even this academy?!
They're s'posed to have enough cash to build an Ivory Tower every year!
What the actual heck!
Hrm. I can't ignore such a claim.
Memo memo...
Today, we would like you to offer us
your most original business ideas!
Let's make Landosol a more exciting place!
I can't wait to work with you all!
